articles.title: Letter: the Mill Hill Lions Club Did a Good Job This Fall
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the bus shelter in the budget. Many of us on Ridge Road use it every week.

I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Ridge Road for 38 years, and I want to say what a difference the Mill Hill Lions Club has made.
Rosalind Abernathy, Lower Millrace
